description.narrative: The Government of Niger had agreed to establish as its starting point for sustained aggregate reduction in HCFC consumption an estimated baseline of 16.0 ODP tonnes, calculated using actual consumption of 16.0 ODP tonnes reported for 2009 under the HPMP and 16.0 ODP tonnes reported for 2010 under Article 7 of the Montreal Protocol. The Project aims to deduct 5.60 ODP tonnes of HCFCs from the starting point for sustained aggregate reduction in HCFC consumption.
